ctx.x: I have a photo here of the Billy Taylor band. David Frost show, 1969­ 1972. [It was] Bobby Thomas on drums, Bob Cranshaw on bass George Burg…
Yeah, Bob left after a couple of months and he was replaced by Wilbur Bascomb, who worked he rest of the show.
… Jimmy Owens, Dick Hurwitz on trumpet, and Morty Bullman on trombone.
